events.title: Encrypted Pre-Dispatch Chat
events.description: DarkWeb Signal relay registers encrypted chat between offshore buyer and Ryan Mehta discussing $150k Chimera payload bounty.

events.title: Evening Sequencing Run Begins
events.description: Dr. Maya Rao initializes the Project Chimera genome sequencing pipeline on Apex Bio-Lab Server Cluster 01.

events.title: Arjun & Nisha Coffee Meeting
events.description: Arjun Kulkarni and Nisha Kapoor arrive at Costa Cafe and sit together reviewing journal submissions.

events.title: Maya Departs for Cafeteria
events.description: Dr. Maya leaves her lab office to purchase coffee downstairs, inadvertently leaving her keycard on the desk.

events.title: Unauthorized Keycard Badge Scan
events.description: Apex Bio-Lab Door #3 badge reader is unlocked using Maya's stolen Keycard KC-9021 while Maya is in the cafeteria line.

events.title: Library SSH Reverse Tunnel Launch
events.description: Central Library IP 192.168.40.88 launches scripted reverse SSH tunnel, simulating active presence at library terminal.

events.title: Terminal 04 USB Exfiltration
events.description: SanDisk 128GB USB drive mounted to Lab Workstation 04; file 'chimera_dump.tar.gz' copied from encrypted vault.
events.significance: Theft of the Confidential Research File

events.title: CCTV Fire Staircase Escape
events.description: CCTV Camera 04 records hooded individual in navy Gore-Tex jacket exiting the rear emergency stairs towards the library path.
events.significance: Direct Physical Sighting at Crime Scene

events.title: Accomplice Switch Log Erasure
events.description: Sam Verma sends encrypted message confirming port mirror wiping and planning physical drive handoff.

events.title: Discovery of the Crime
events.description: Dr. Maya returns to the 3rd floor lab, finds workstation session terminated, vault storage empty, and immediately contacts security.

events.title: Lockdown & Digital Forensics Summoned
events.description: Campus security places Research Block 4 on quarantine lockdown and initiates the Digital Forensics investigation.
